propositions: Ticket directory and its first event file are created non-atomically today (mkdir outside lock, first event file inside lock), leaving stray empty directories if interrupted between makedirs and event write
New staging.py module stages event and directory together in a temp path named .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex>, then publishes atomically via os.rename under the write lock
Temp paths are invisible to fsck checks because they are dot-prefixed and existing scanner rules already skip dot-prefixed entries
All dir-then-file sites in the store write path (event_append batch path, reconciler inbound translate, BRIDGE_ALERT emission) are converted to use staged atomic publication or verified as exempt
Stale temp paths owned by dead processes are swept at writer start using process metadata (host, pid-namespace, start-time) to defeat pid recycling, bounded per AC3 constraints
